scope.otherSets: One alphabetically selected ordinary English nonfoil high-resolution printing per available material. Raw scan visual transfer only; not accepted alignment measurements.

method:
Compare source families with one candidate geometry per Legends material.

Scan poses are frozen upstream. Independent calibration/validation UUIDs were
chosen before this study. Signed grayscale gradients suppress color/saturation
differences; scores are diagnostic cosine similarity, not card accuracy percent.
This CPU-only search does not recapture a browser or fit any scan to a candidate.
sourceGeometry: Current source, existing Fourth inset, existing Revised land crop, ABU; alternate Legends control for gold. Color calibration disabled. Candidate art aperture follows its frame. One axis scale/translation per material and family; no scan refitting.
decoding: All source plates use the production 768-pixel decode width, then the ordinary 732 × 1020 inspect raster normalized to 488 × 680. Supersedes the initial native-resolution candidate study. Fourth gold aperture measured from native alpha: [158,187,1348,1141] in 1500 × 2100 pixels.

rendererReplay.method: Replay shared frame/art geometry in the renderer, retaining all text placement and frozen scans. Compare actual boundary profiles with the CPU interpolation prediction. No pixel scores have been published.

goldTexture.method:
Diagnostic texture spectrum, separate from boundary geometry scoring.

Normalize grayscale band energies within fixed outer-frame patches so changes
in overall brightness/contrast do not count as texture improvements. This is
not a scan-accuracy metric: scan halftoning/resampling also changes the spectrum.
goldTexture.limitation: Exploratory band-energy diagnostic, affected by scan halftoning and resampling. Not incorporated into published accuracy metric.
